key_idea: Use floor(N/2) groups: all 2s, with one of them replaced by a 3 when N is odd.
sketch: Print K=N/2 and then K numbers, the first being 3 if N is odd and the rest 2. O(N) output, build it in one string. Any decomposition is accepted, so the sample token compare fails; I checked with my own validator (sum equals N, all parts 2 or 3) for N=2..59 and N near 1e6.
